newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU calls on China to hold Hong Kong elections.
newsitem.headline: EU calls on China to hold Hong Kong elections.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday called on China to hold legislative elections within 12 months of the July 1 handover from Britain, British Foreign Secretary Robin Cook said.

Cook told reporters after a meeting of EU foreign ministers that he also hoped a number of EU ministers would, like Britain, stay away from the swearing-in ceremony of the Beijing-appointed legislature.
Cook said China's decision to remove the current legislature with an appointed body was "a clear breach of democratic values."
He said he had not asked Britain's EU counterparts to join in a ministerial boycott of the sewaring-in ceremony but that "a number of countries indicated that for them it is an open question."

Cook said he believed these ministers -- whom he did not name -- would skip the ceremony once they arrived in the colony for the handover and discovered how large an issue it was for the people there.
He also said the European Commission and the European Parliament had decided to boycott the swearing in.
